knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 8,
                      fig.height = 6)

```{r packages}
library(aqsurface)
library(sf)
library(terra)
```

## Data

Stations and pollutants are loaded from the legacy archives that ship
with the original analysis. We split monitors into a training set
(Fixed background sites) and a held-out set (Road sites).

```{r data, eval = FALSE}
data_dir <- "../Code/Data"
stations <- make_station_sf(file.path(data_dir, "stations_10km.shp"))
parts    <- split_stations(stations)

train_pm10 <- load_pollutant(
  file.path(data_dir, "pm10.RData"),
  season = "winter", station_type = "bk",
  stations = parts$train
)

targets <- decade_columns("pm10", month = 1, decade = "S1")
grid    <- build_prediction_grid(train_pm10, n_x = 200, n_y = 200)
```

## Universal kriging

```{r uk, eval = FALSE}
uk <- predict_surface_batch(
  data    = train_pm10,
  targets = targets,
  newgrid = grid,
  method  = "uk",
  trend   = "const",
  cutoff  = 30000,
  width   = 3000,
  model   = "Ste"
)

plot_variogram_grid(uk$models, ncol = 5)
plot_surface_facet(uk$pred, boundary = NULL, limits = c(0, 150), ncol = 5)
```

## GAM

```{r gam, eval = FALSE}
gam <- predict_surface_batch(
  data    = train_pm10,
  targets = targets,
  newgrid = grid,
  method  = "gam",
  smooth  = "tp",
  method  = "REML"
)

plot_surface_facet(gam$pred, limits = c(0, 150), ncol = 5)
```

## Validation against Road monitors

```{r validation, eval = FALSE}
holdout_pm10 <- load_pollutant(
  file.path(data_dir, "pm10.RData"),
  season = "winter", station_type = "rd",
  stations = parts$holdout
)

uk_long  <- extract_at_stations(uk$pred,  holdout_pm10, targets)
gam_long <- extract_at_stations(gam$pred, holdout_pm10, targets)

uk_metrics  <- compute_metrics(uk_long,  by = "target")
gam_metrics <- compute_metrics(gam_long, by = "target")

dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(uk_metrics,  method = "UK"),
  dplyr::mutate(gam_metrics, method = "GAM")
)
```

## Road-side post-processing (legacy comparison)

```{r road, eval = FALSE}
ratio_tbl <- tidy_ratio_table(
  read_pollutant_rdata(file.path(data_dir, "pm10.RData"))$win_ratio,
  targets = targets
)

road_raster <- terra::rast(file.path(data_dir, "..", "road_10km_re.tif"))
uk_with_road <- apply_road_ratio(uk$pred, road_raster, ratio_tbl)
```
